ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. where is the library
   B. Where is the library
   C. Where is the Library
   D. Where is the library?

2. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a joining word
   B. A person, place, thing, or idea
   C. Only an action
   D. Only a describing word

3. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.

4. When practising Guided Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Guided Writing.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Guided Writing.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Guided Writing.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Writing.

5. When practising Punctuation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Punctuation.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Punctuation.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Punctuation.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Punctuation.

6. When practising Spelling, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Spelling.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Spelling.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Spelling.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Spelling.

7. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.

8. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. happiness
   B. run
   C. blue
   D. quickly

9. When practising Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Attentive Listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Attentive Listening.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening.

10. When practising Language Activities at home, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Language Activities at home.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Language Activities at home.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Activities at home.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Language Activities at home.

11. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.

12. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Spelling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

2. B — A person, place, thing, or idea

8. B — run

10. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Activities at home.

11. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.

12. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Punctuation; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Guided Writing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
